mapper.select: select p.package_id as packageId, p.package_code as packageCode, p.package_name as packageName, p.source_type as sourceType, p.custom_flag as customFlag, p.platform_package_id as platformPackageId, p.class_id as classId, p.model_id as modelId, p.status, p.sort_no as sortNo, v.package_version_id as packageVersionId, v.version_no as versionNo, v.bom_hash as bomHash from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package p left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_version v on v.package_id=p.package_id and v.version_status=1 and v.is_delete=0 where p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and p.member_id=#{memberId} and p.is_delete=0 and (p.package_code like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or p.package_name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) and p.status=#{status} order by p.create_time desc, p.package_id desc

select package_id as packageId, package_code as packageCode, package_name as packageName, source_type as sourceType, custom_flag as customFlag, platform_package_id as platformPackageId, class_id as classId, model_id as modelId, status, sort_no as sortNo, remark from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and package_id=#{packageId} and is_delete=0

select i.package_item_id as packageItemId, i.item_role as itemRole, i.product_id as productId, i.accessory_id as accessoryId, i.accessory_item_product_id as accessoryItemProductId, i.merchant_accessory_id as merchantAccessoryId, case when i.item_role in (1, 4) then p.product_name when i.item_role = 3 then coalesce(ma.accessory_name, p.product_name) when i.item_role = 2 then '官方配件' end as itemName, p.product_code as itemCode, p.model_name as itemModelName, p.product_type as productType, p.stock_mode as stockMode, i.quantity, i.required_flag as requiredFlag, i.sort_no as sortNo from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_item i left join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id = coalesce(i.product_id, i.accessory_item_product_id) and p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and p.member_id = i.member_id and p.is_delete = 0 left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory ma on ma.accessory_id = i.merchant_accessory_id and ma.tenant_id = i.tenant_id and ma.member_id = i.member_id and ma.is_delete = 0 where i.package_version_id=#{packageVersionId} and i.is_delete=0 order by i.sort_no, i.package_item_id

select package_version_id as packageVersionId, package_id as packageId from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_version where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and package_id=#{packageId} and version_status=1 and is_delete=0 order by version_no desc limit 1

select product_id, class_id, model_id, product_type, product_name, product_code, model_name from ry_business.ry_rental_product where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and product_id=#{productId} and status=0 and is_delete=0 and (product_type=1 or product_type='device' or product_type=2 or product_type='accessory') limit 1

select product_id, class_id, model_id, product_type, product_name, product_code, model_name from ry_business.ry_rental_product where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and model_id=#{modelId} and status=0 and is_delete=0 and (product_type=1 or product_type='device' or product_type=2 or product_type='accessory') order by product_type, product_id limit 1

select p.product_id, p.model_id, p.product_type, a.accessory_id as merchant_accessory_id from ry_business.ry_rental_product p left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory a on a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id and a.member_id=p.member_id and a.product_id=p.product_id and a.is_delete=0 where p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and p.member_id=#{memberId} and p.product_id=#{productId} and (p.product_type=2 or p.product_type='accessory') and p.is_delete=0 limit 1

select accessory_id, product_id, class_id, custom_flag, status from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and accessory_id=#{accessoryId} and custom_flag=1 and status=0 and is_delete=0 limit 1

select a.accessory_id as merchantAccessoryId, a.product_id as productId, a.accessory_code as productCode, p.product_name as productName, a.class_id as classId, group_concat(am.model_id order by am.model_id separator ',') as compatibleModelIds from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory a join ry_business.ry_rental_product p on p.product_id=a.product_id and p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and p.member_id=a.member_id and p.is_delete=0 and (p.product_type=2 or p.product_type='accessory') left join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory_model am on am.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and am.member_id=a.member_id and am.accessory_id=a.accessory_id and am.is_delete=0 where a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a.member_id=#{memberId} and a.custom_flag=1 and a.status=0 and a.is_delete=0
and exists (select 1 from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory_model compatible_model where compatible_model.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and compatible_model.member_id=a.member_id and compatible_model.accessory_id=a.accessory_id and compatible_model.model_id=#{modelId} and compatible_model.is_delete=0)
group by a.accessory_id, a.product_id, a.accessory_code, p.product_name, a.class_id order by a.create_time desc, a.accessory_id desc

select a.accessory_id, a.product_id from ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory a join ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_accessory_model am on am.tenant_id=a.tenant_id and am.member_id=a.member_id and am.accessory_id=a.accessory_id and am.model_id=#{modelId} and am.is_delete=0 where a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a.member_id=#{memberId} and a.custom_flag=1 and a.status=0 and a.is_delete=0 order by a.create_time, a.accessory_id limit 1
mapper.update: update ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package set class_id=#{classId}, model_id=#{modelId}, package_name=#{packageName}, custom_flag=1, status=#{status}, sort_no=#{sortNo}, update_by=#{operator}, update_time=now(), remark=#{remark} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and package_id=#{packageId} and is_delete=0

update ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package set is_delete=1, remove_by=#{operator}, remove_time=now(), update_by=#{operator}, update_time=now() where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and package_id=#{packageId} and is_delete=0

update ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_version set is_delete=1, version_status=2, remove_by=#{operator}, remove_time=now(), update_by=#{operator}, update_time=now() where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and member_id=#{memberId} and package_id=#{packageId} and is_delete=0

update ry_business.ry_rental_merchant_package_item set is_delete=1, remove_by=#{operator}, remove_time=now(), update_by=#{operator}, update_time=now() where package_version_id=#{packageVersionId} and is_delete=0
